title: Johnny Costa - Data Engineer (EN)
summary: Data Engineer and Analyst with over 3 years of experience developing ETL pipelines, cloud solutions, and Business Intelligence tools for the automotive engineering and financial sectors (GCP, AWS, BigQuery, Python, SQL). Proven track record of delivering measurable business impact: 80% recall in ML fraud detection model, 60% faster team query response times, and 70% reduction in data prep time. Currently expanding expertise in advanced AWS data architectures and Databricks.

bulletItems.text: Engineered automated web scraping pipeline to collect and ingest 1,000+ vehicle records, reducing data collection cycle time from days to under 2 hours and establishing a continuous data pipeline for engineering analysis (Python, BigQuery).

Built and automated ETL pipeline for data normalization and loading into BigQuery, reducing manual data prep time by ~70% and enabling seamless consumption for 10+ users and analytics tools (Python, BigQuery, GCP).

Optimized Looker Studio dashboard querying terabyte-scale BigQuery tables — implemented partitioning strategies that reduced query execution times by ~65%, delivering real-time data for technical decision-making (BigQuery, SQL).

Developing internal full-stack tool for Ford North America to replace manual Excel workflows — projected +50% reduction in analysis turn-around time, featuring user management, file uploading, and interactive charts (Python, Streamlit, Pandas, PostgreSQL).

Designed automated email monitoring workflow using Power Automate and JavaScript to track overdue tasks and alert supervisors in real time — eliminating ~3h/week of manual follow-ups and publishing executive Power BI dashboards (Power Automate, Power BI, JavaScript).
Developed scalable ETL pipeline in Python on GCP and BigQuery, accelerating vehicle telemetry data loading and preparation times by 70%.
Co-developed Machine Learning model for vehicle weight estimation, delivering predictive insights at overall and subsystem levels directly utilized by engineering teams (Python, ML, Streamlit).
Automated data ingestion and transformation in BigQuery using optimized SQL queries, reducing time-to-insight generation by ~40% for technical staff.
Built Machine Learning model with Python and Apache Spark for suspicious transaction prediction, achieving 80% Recall rate and significantly improving detection accuracy.
Created Python script to automate credit fraud tracking by analyzing phone numbers, emails, and physical addresses, speeding up fraud identification by 80%.
Engineered and maintained ETL processes using Python, SQL, and Power BI, enabling proactive risk mitigation and reducing team incident response time by 65%.
Modeled and developed executive KPI dashboards in Power BI (DAX & M), driving a minimum estimated savings of $200k+ by preventing fraudulent activity.
Implemented Kanban agile methodology using Trello, boosting team task execution efficiency and workflow transparency by 50%.
